description: I am a dedicated student interested in programming, technology, and problem-solving. I have basic knowledge of Python, C++, and Kotlin. I am looking for motivated team members with skills in programming, database management, research, and good communication.
summary: This project explores NASA equipment left behind in space, highlighting five examples from the Moon, Mars, and beyond. It tells the stories of their missions, achievements, and what happens to them after their work is done.
details: Our project uses research and visual storytelling to explore five examples of NASA equipment left behind in space. It explains their original missions, achievements, and current condition, making space exploration easier to understand for school-age audiences. The project aims to raise awareness about the history of space exploration and the legacy of these machines. It was developed using research, written content, and visual illustrations, with a focus on scientific accuracy, simplicity, and creativity.
